list.none: No service enabled. Open ⚙ to choose.
card.logout.title: Forget the login for this service
card.login_needed: Sign in to see your quotas.
card.stale: Showing the last reading; this update failed.
s.notifications_hint: Notify when a window reaches 90% or renews.
s.windows_empty: Enable the service and refresh to list its usage windows.
s.keys_local: API keys are stored in ~/.quotawidget and encrypted with Windows.
s.config_hint: Backups and exports contain the encrypted config. API keys are never decrypted outside the app.
s.config_import_confirm: Importing replaces all current settings, keys and custom providers. Continue?
s.config_reset_confirm: Reset all settings, keys and custom providers? A backup will be created first.
s.config_restarting: Config applied. The app will restart.
s.custom_hint: Custom providers use a guided form or a JSON spec. The spec is stored as-is; put secrets only in the API key field.
s.custom_detail: This is a custom provider. Edit its spec to change the URL, auth and response mapping.
s.custom_delete_confirm: Delete this custom provider and its API key?
s.custom_mapping_hint: Use dot paths like data.used.percent (arrays: items[0].value) or safe expressions like =Math.round(data.value). Add at least one window or a note template.
s.custom_expr_help_intro: Prefix a mapping value with = to use an expression. Without =, it is a dot path. data is the whole response; top-level keys also work.
s.custom_expr_help_math: Math: round, floor, ceil, abs, min, max, pow, sqrt
s.custom_expr_help_functions: Functions: Number, String, Boolean, parseInt, parseFloat, isFinite
s.custom_expr_help_methods: Methods: toFixed, toLocaleString, trim, toUpperCase, toLowerCase
s.custom_expr_help_ops:
Operators: + - * / % **, comparisons, && || ! and ? :
Not available: require, process, Function, constructors, assignment or loops.
s.custom_expr_help_where: Use in percent, reset, detail, note values and plan.
s.custom_key_hint: Stored encrypted in ~/.quotawidget. Leave empty to keep the current key.
s.custom_failed: Could not delete the custom provider.
s.custom_test_empty: Response matched no windows or note.
s.custom_guided_complex: This spec has multiple windows or note values. Use JSON to edit it.
s.custom_template_confirm: Replace the mapping with this template? The name, URL, auth, headers and API key stay unchanged.
s.custom_load_invalid: Could not read that JSON file.
s.custom_headers_invalid: Extra headers must be a JSON object.
s.custom_note_template_hint: Press Enter for a new line.
